I saved the date to memory and replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message.

- **What I recorded:** the signed order form for Quarrendon Freight Lines is due 7 October 2026. Ilse said no action was needed, so I didn't take any.
- **One thing that doesn't fit:** the sim clock says today is 16 October, so 7 October had already passed when Ilse posted. In my reply I asked whether she meant another date, such as 7 November.

I kept this as a separate memory from the existing Greywater order-form deadline because it's a different account.
